title: Deep linear networks: learning dynamics through the SVD
summary: Deep linear networks compute a product of matrices yet learn in stages; gradient flow analysed through the singular value decomposition of the input–output correlation; representational similarity analysis; illusory correlations during training; learning rates and other hyperparameters as a preview.
